goal: Find a medium-turnover Binance Spot long-only strategy that survives realistic costs and the existing Round 2 evidence gate.

MTF_TREND_BREAKOUT.entry: close above prior breakout high, close>EMA200, EMA50>EMA200, EMA50 rising over 6 bars
MTF_TREND_BREAKOUT.exit: STOP_FIRST; otherwise trailing stop from peak; otherwise close<EMA50 or maxHold

TREND_PULLBACK_RECLAIM.entry: close>EMA200, EMA50>EMA200, recent low touched within 0.60 ATR of EMA50, current close reclaims prior 3-bar high, RSI 45..65
TREND_PULLBACK_RECLAIM.exit: STOP_FIRST; otherwise trailing stop from peak; otherwise close<EMA50 or maxHold

VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_TREND.entry: close>EMA200, ATR/close was in bottom quartile of prior 120 bars within last 6 bars, current close breaks prior 20-bar high
VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_TREND.exit: STOP_FIRST; otherwise trailing stop from peak; otherwise close<EMA200 or maxHold
